notes.title: About: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content: [p]Eterspire already comes from portable platforms on mobile and has full controller support. Steam Deck players have reported that the game runs smoothly, with character movement, combat, and menus all working seamlessly.[/p][p]We’re still waiting on Steam’s official review process to see if Eterspire will be classified as [i]Playable[/i] or [i]Verified[/i].[/p][p]If you’re playing on Steam Deck, we’d love to hear from you! Please share your experiences and let us know how the game runs for you. Your feedback helps is always appreciated![/p]

notes.title: About: Eterspire's Update Schedule
notes.content: [p][b]Eterspire is updated roughly once every two weeks.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Eterspire updates release on the 14th and 28th, unless that day falls on a Friday, holiday, or weekend, in which case it will be released on the next business day. We follow this schedule to ensure we're available in the office the day after an update, in case any issues arise.[/p][p align="start"]Since we are located in the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina, updates are released during Argentine business hours, between 10:00 and 18:00 (GMT-3). Release times may vary, depending on the workload required for each update.[/p]

notes.title: Eterspire 59.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680663/3593f9047c29241b4553f88dc2ba9f0cdcbec303.png"][/img]
[/p][p]This is a bit of a strange update, as we're releasing it outside our [url="https://www.eterspire.com/release_schedule"]regular update schedule[/url]. We weren’t planning to release anything before the Steam / Mac App Store launch, but we had to implement some last-minute changes, and so, Eterspire 59.0 is here![/p][p align="start"]This is mostly a maintenance and stability update.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Content, Features & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]A new level 90 map: Mount Magma, a burning volcano full of powerful beasts![/p][/*][*][p]This week we introduced the [url="https://www.eterspire.com/creators/"]Eterspire Content Creators Kit[/url], which includes high-resolution artwork, screenshots, gameplay footage, item sprites, in-game music, and everything you need to create Eterspire content![/p][/*][*][p]Although this has been live for over a week, we've now officially added a level cap for Extra Levels at level 160+4000, following popular request.[/p][/*][*][p]We've reduced the minimum level required to access server chat to level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]We've lowered the default graphics quality setting on iOS to Mid to better support lower-spec devices. You can always raise it back up in the Settings menu![/p][/*][*][p]Steam Beta: we've added a button in the Settings menu to toggle between Fullscreen and Windowed mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680663/4ceeb5ba4cd41978aef6a7de05e706a4d4752e44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Eterspire Store[/h2][list][*][p]We've renamed the Sakura Blossom katanas, as the previous names weren’t very descriptive and lacked flavor.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]The cosmetic items from the Sakura Blossom set no longer project real-time shadows.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the voices and sound effects added in Eterspire 58.0 had incorrect volume levels; we've fixed them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some colliders in the maps introduced in Eterspire 58.0.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the positioning of some buggy mobs introduced in Eterspire 58.0.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Beta: fixed a bug that caused some Eterspire Store prices to display in the wrong currency.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The Firefly Forest map has been renamed to Firefly Grove to avoid confusion with the Firefly Forest as a broader area.[/p][/*][*][p]A quick reminder: due to the upcoming Steam release for PC and Mac App Store release for macOS on September 15th, we've added additional information to the login menu on how to create [url="https://www.eterspire.com/eterspire-credentials"]Eterspire Credentials[/url] for your account, so you can log in cross-platform.[/p][/*][/list][h2]In Other News...[/h2][list][*][p]We're working hard on the finishing touches for the macOS and PC releases (coming to the Mac App Store and Steam, respectively). These versions will launch on September 15th, so make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144600/Eterspire/"]wishlist Eterspire on Steam[/url] before then; it would mean a lot to us![/p][/*][*][p]Again, we know it's been a while since we released content for players who are already at endgame and max level. In the upcoming updates, we'll be focusing on bringing new content to you! We have a lot of great things planned, so please stay tuned![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update very much! See you on September 15th for the PC and macOS release![/p]

notes.title: Eterspire 58.0 (Our last update before our Steam release!)
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680663/3593f9047c29241b4553f88dc2ba9f0cdcbec303.png"][/img][/h3][h3]
New Content, Features & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Visit two new locations with unique friends, foes, and treasures to discover: the Northern Tundra for players level 65 or higher, and Fungi Island for players level 105 or higher.[/p][/*][*][p]A new quest: [b]Grand Opening![/b] Wanda wants to finally open her own boutique. If you're up to help her, you can start this quest by talking to her in Vestada![/p][/*][*][p]We've removed the cap on extra levels, so you can now level up higher than ever before! New rewards for these levels will be introduced soon.[/p][/*][*][p]We've introduced Game Center Leaderboards so you can compete with your friends and other Game Center users![/p][/*][*][p]We've expanded all translations and have especially reviewed much of the Spanish localization. We're working hard to improve translations in all supported languages![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680663/51d8a96cf0b874543ec3798ce0a80699d96f170b.png"][/img]
[/h3][h3]Eterspire Store[/h3][list][*][p]A new cosmetic box: the Sakura Blossoms set! Dress in elegant Eastern style with this perfect balance of beauty and tradition![/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680663/c0e2f9c688cf3f8aea9f5327c07d5316a50baad6.png"][/img][/p][h3]
Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some UI scaling issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the stability of Game Center achievements, which sometimes failed to work.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple other minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Due to the upcoming Steam release for PC and Mac App Store release for macOS on September 15th, we've added additional information to the login menu about how to create [url="https://www.eterspire.com/eterspire-credentials"]Eterspire Credentials[/url] for your account, so you can log in cross-platform.[/p][/*][/list][h3]In Other News...[/h3][list][*][p]We're working hard on the finishing touches for the macOS and PC releases (coming to the Mac App Store and Steam, respectively). These versions will launch on September 15th, so make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144600/Eterspire/"]wishlist Eterspire on Steam[/url] before then — it would mean a lot to us![/p][/*][*][p]We know it's been a while since we released content for players who are already at endgame and max level. In the upcoming updates, we'll be focusing on bringing new content you! We have a lot of great things planned, so please stay tunned![/p][/*][/list][h3]Community[/h3][list][*][p]Our latest community screenshot contest has ended. We loved seeing all of your super creative entries!![/p][/*][*][p]All event participants and winners will receive their rewards shortly. Make sure to update to Eterspire 58.0 or higher to be able to receive your prize![/p][/*][*][p]A new community event with crystal rewards will begin on August 28th! Stay tuned for more info![/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]We hope you enjoy this update very much! See you on September 15th for the PC and macOS release![/b][/p]
